We propose CALD (Calibrated Anchor-Loss Disagreement), a lightweight unsupervised monitor that triggers an alarm to warn when a PFN might fail. By finetuning the decoder to maximize disagreement with the test-set prediction while maintaining accuracy on an ID anchor set, CALD identifies harmful OOD batches through the resulting anchor loss, requiring no labels on test batches. We prove that the post-finetune anchor loss has a strictly lower expectation under sufficiently severe shift than under ID eval, yielding a one-sided test. Across 14 datasets covering tabular and structured distribution shift, on both TabPFN and TabICL, CALD matches or outperforms baselines on harmful shifts and is markedly more resilient to benign-shift false alarms.

summary.takeaway: 提出无监督监控器CALD，通过微调解码器使其在保持域内锚点集准确率的同时最大化与测试预测的分歧，用锚点损失触发分布外失败告警，并在严重偏移下具有严格更低的期望。
summary.methods: 对解码器进行锚点损失分歧微调，以微调后锚点损失作单侧检验；在14个覆盖表格与结构化分布偏移的数据集上，于TabPFN与TabICL上对比基线。
summary.relevance: 针对表格基础模型（PFN）在部署时分布偏移下可能静默失败的问题，属于预训练模型可靠性与分布外检测范畴。
summary.caveat: 评估限于14个数据集与两种PFN模型，告警阈值与“损害性偏移”的定义依赖实验设置；摘要未说明在极端或混合偏移下的误报/漏报率细节。

papers.title: ChemoMAE: Self-Supervised Spectral Representation Learning Reveals Chemical Heterogeneity in Historical Wood
papers.abstract: In historical timber buildings, multiple environmental factors act over centuries on wood whose chemical composition varies across anatomical regions, producing complex patterns of degradation. Understanding how timber members degrade is important for the effective conservation and restoration of historical buildings, yet the mechanisms underlying these patterns remain unclear. To investigate these mechanisms, we used self-supervised learning to establish a common basis for comparing specimens from timber members that differ in wood species and service history. We examined transverse sections of 49 wood specimens from several historical buildings in Japan using near-infrared hyperspectral imaging. ChemoMAE, a self-supervised Transformer, learns pixelwise spectral representations through masked denoising that exploits multicollinearity among spectral variables. Clustering these representations yields spatial maps without predefined chemical-state categories. Because anatomy and degradation can produce spatially continuous regions, we formulated Local Label Agreement (LLA) to quantify agreement among labels assigned to neighboring pixels. Using spectra alone, ChemoMAE yielded higher mean LLA than baseline methods on validation specimens. We then trained ChemoMAE anew and fitted cluster centers across all specimens. Spatial structures consistent with wood anatomy and the expected effects of surface exposure emerged in the resulting maps. By cross-referencing regional spectra and spatial distributions across specimens in light of wood anatomy, service histories, and prior studies, we proposed models of internal and surface degradation as mechanistic hypotheses. This exploratory AI for Science framework gives researchers a basis for linking latent patterns learned through self-supervision with domain knowledge when investigating how material states form.

summary.takeaway: 提出ChemoMAE，用自监督掩码去噪学习近红外高光谱像素级光谱表征，并通过聚类生成无需预定义化学状态类别的空间图谱，以探索历史木材的化学异质性。
summary.methods: 对来自日本多座历史建筑的49个木材试样的横截面做近红外高光谱成像；以自监督Transformer ChemoMAE利用光谱变量间的多重共线性进行掩码去噪，学习像素表征；聚类表征得到空间图；提出Local Label Agreement（LLA）量化邻域标签一致性，并在验证试样上与基线比较。
summary.relevance: 属于自监督与表示学习主题：它用自监督预训练获取可迁移的光谱表征，并将表征聚类结果与领域知识关联。
summary.caveat: 摘要显示研究为探索性、假设生成性质；降解模型是基于解剖结构、服役历史和既有研究提出的机制假设，未经实验验证；且样本仅限日本历史建筑木材。

papers.title: Analemma $\infty$: A Temporal Benchmark for Geospatial Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Satellite time series capture how land surfaces change over time. Pixel-wise temporal foundation models read a year of satellite observations per pixel, yet public benchmarks lack a temporal axis or subsample it to a few dates. We introduce Analemma, a temporal benchmark of six datasets that carry every 10 and 20 m Sentinel-2 band and a time series spanning a growing season, completed where their releases omit geometry, dates, or cloud masks. One frozen-encoder protocol evaluates all models across label ratios and three seeds, with two baselines without pretraining. The TESSERA model ranks first overall. A from-scratch model on monthly composites outranks every foundation model except OlmoEarth v1.3-Base, suggesting that temporal input explains most of the performance. Three evaluation choices left unstated by the source publications each shift TESSERA v1 by 7.6 to 18.6 mIoU, against top-two gaps of 0.6 to 2.8. Data, harness and leaderboard will be publicly released soon.

summary.takeaway: 发布Analemma时间基准，包含六个覆盖完整生长季Sentinel-2全波段时间序列的数据集，用于评估地理空间基础模型的时序能力。
summary.methods: 构建六个数据集，补齐发布中缺失的几何、日期或云掩膜；采用统一冻结编码器协议，在不同标签比例和三个随机种子下评测，并设两个无预训练基线；比较TESSERA、OlmoEarth v1.3-Base等模型。
summary.relevance: 属于预训练主题：它系统评测时序基础模型的预训练表征在遥感任务上的迁移表现，并分析输入时间维度与评测设计的影响。
summary.caveat: 数据、评测框架和排行榜尚未公开，仅称即将发布；结论基于摘要所述基准设置，具体数据集构成与统计细节未给出。

papers.title: BoolFunc-EA: A Boolean-evolutionary approach for accurate inference of gene regulatory networks from time-series gene expression data.
papers.abstract: Network inference is the process of discovering genetic information from time-series data. The inference of gene regulatory networks from time-series data represents a significant challenge in bioinformatics. Despite the development of many Boolean network inference methods, most struggle with scalability as they impose restrictions on regulatory genes for each target gene. Other methods suffer from local optimum issues or are unable to compute the exact mutual information between a regulatory gene and its target gene. To resolve these issues, we present a novel method referred to as BoolFunc-EA, which employs Boolean functions and a genetic algorithm to infer gene regulatory networks from time-series gene expression data. BoolFunc-EA is a two-stage algorithm. First, we employ a set of limited Boolean functions to search for a regulatory gene. If a regulatory gene is not identified at this stage, a genetic algorithm is applied to determine a set of regulatory genes. In particular, this study introduces a hybrid crossover operator and a new fitness function that enhances information inheritance, improves solution evaluation, and provides a more effective solution representation within the proposed genetic algorithm framework. To assess the effectiveness of BoolFunc-EA, we conducted a wide range of experiments on both artificial and real gene expression datasets. Findings from the artificial dataset reveal that BoolFunc-EA consistently outperforms benchmark methods, including LogicGEP, LogBTF, MIBNI, LBF-MI, CLR, RelNet, Genie3-time, dynGenie3, and Jump3. The proposed method was further evaluated on the budding yeast cell cycle network and on fifty gene regulatory network datasets generated using the GNW tool. Its performance was then compared with that of nine benchmark methods. Results from real gene expression datasets also show that BoolFunc-EA consistently achieves superior F-score values, even on biological networks. Taken together, BoolFunc-EA is an efficient, scalable, and robust tool for gene regulatory network inference. The source code and reproducible experimental results are freely accessible at https://github.com/Dr-Shohag-Barman/BoolFunc-EA.

summary.takeaway: 提出BoolFunc-EA，结合布尔函数与遗传算法从时间序列基因表达数据推断基因调控网络，并在人工与真实数据集上报告优于多个基准方法。
summary.methods: 两阶段算法：先用有限布尔函数搜索调控基因，未识别时用遗传算法确定调控基因集合；引入混合交叉算子和新适应度函数；在人工数据集、 budding yeast细胞周期网络及GNW生成的五十个网络数据集上，与LogicGEP、LogBTF、MIBNI、LBF-MI、CLR、RelNet、Genie3-time、dynGenie3、Jump3等九种方法比较F-score。
summary.relevance: 直接对应GRN/Regulon主题：方法目标即从时序表达数据重建基因调控网络。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告F-score类指标；真实数据规模与噪声条件下的泛化能力、可扩展性上限及计算成本未在摘要中量化。

papers.title: Tablassert: Declarative Extraction of Knowledge Graphs from Biomedical Tables
papers.abstract: Tables published in biomedical research papers, particularly supplemental tables, capture knowledge assertions that may not be in the main text of the manuscript for several reasons, including low statistical significance, space limitations, and narrative scope. These tables include data (e.g., association statistics, assay readouts, curated gene lists, and omics) encoding relationships between biological entities. Tablassert converts such tabular data (Excel, CSV, TSV, Parquet) into knowledge graphs ready for the NCATS Biomedical Data Translator (Fecho et al. 2025). A user declares in YAML how each table's data map to subject-predicate-object-qualifier statements; Tablassert resolves free text (e.g., ''lung cancer'') to standard identifiers, attaches provenance and statistics, and emits graph files conforming to Translator standards (D. Unni, Bruskiewich, and Moxon 2026; D. R. Unni et al. 2022).

summary.takeaway: 提出Tablassert，通过YAML声明式映射把生物医学表格数据转换为符合NCATS Biomedical Data Translator标准的知识图谱。
summary.methods: 用户用YAML声明表格列到subject-predicate-object-qualifier语句的映射；Tablassert解析自由文本为标准化标识符，附加来源与统计信息，输出Translator标准图文件；支持Excel、CSV、TSV、Parquet输入。
summary.relevance: 属于知识图谱主题：面向生物医学文献补充表格的知识抽取与图谱构建。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出抽取准确率、覆盖范围或用户研究等定量评估；对复杂表格结构和歧义消解的鲁棒性未说明。

papers.title: Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge to Guide Continual Learning
papers.abstract: The goal of continual learning (CL) is to adapt to new data (plasticity) while retaining the knowledge acquired from old data (stability). Existing methods are explicitly designed to focus on balancing stability and plasticity to mitigate the challenge of catastrophic forgetting while promoting learning. However, the impact of order and nature of samples from the new data that the network is trained on remains an under explored factor. We argue that a CL algorithm should have the ability to rank incoming samples in terms of their relationship with prior data and their effect on the learning process. In this work, we investigate if scoring and prioritizing incoming data based on their semantic relationships with the model's current knowledge can benefit CL. We propose SACK, short for Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge, a plug and play technique for continual learning methods. SACK dissects categorical knowledge of the model into fine-grained concepts, computes the relationships between previously learned concepts and new concepts in each experience, and uses this relationship knowledge for prioritizing new samples. Experiments across several types of CL methods (regularization, replay, and prompt based) in class incremental and task incremental settings demonstrate that integration of SACK not only improves accuracy and reduces forgetting but also handles long tail distribution, helps focus on semantically interpretable regions, and yields better calibrated and robust models compared to prior approaches.

summary.takeaway: 提出SACK，将模型类别知识分解为细粒度概念，按新样本与已学概念的语义关系排序，以改善持续学习中的稳定性与可塑性平衡。
summary.methods: 作为即插即用技术，SACK分解类别知识为概念，计算每个经验中新旧概念关系并据此优先采样；在正则化、回放和提示三类持续学习方法上，于类增量和任务增量设置中实验。
summary.relevance: 属于持续学习主题：研究样本顺序与语义关系对灾难性遗忘的影响。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体数据集和数值结果；对概念分解质量依赖及额外计算开销未作说明。

papers.title: Integrating CRISPRi perturbation responses and transcription-factor binding priors for regulatory network inference in triple-negative breast cancer
papers.abstract: Triple-Negative Breast Cancer (TNBC) represents an aggressive breast cancer subtype that lacks actionable cell-surface receptors, restricting frontline systemic management to cytotoxic chemotherapy. While recent functional epigenomics shows that TNBC progression is governed by non-coding regulatory remodeling at distal super-enhancers, conventional Gene Regulatory Network (GRN) inference methods rely on observational transcriptomic co-expression, which suffers from technical dropouts and confounding correlations that inflate false discoveries (>30%). Here, we present an interventional network inference framework that integrates large-scale single-cell CRISPR-interference perturbation sequencing (Perturb-seq; GSE224986, 95,678 cells across 11,975 sgRNAs) with ENCODE Factorbook ChIP-seq physical transcription factor binding priors across 819 somatic mutation-associated enhancer loci in human TNBC (MDA-MB-231). Our pipeline reconstructed a tripartite network yielding 5,935 physical TF-enhancer edges, 383,757 functional enhancer-gene edges, and 542,760 unique TF-target gene functional pairs across 372 active enhancers. Topological centrality prioritized master transcriptional drivers governing TNBC oncogenic signaling, including CTCF, POLR2A, EP300, JUND, MYC, and FOS, which regulate Hallmark programs for Epithelial-Mesenchymal Transition (p = 1.2 x 10-9) and cell cycle progression. Explainable machine learning (SHAP TreeExplainer) revealed non-linear, thresholded transactivation dynamics for AP-1 and MYC. Quantitative benchmarking against held-out CRISPRi ground truth demonstrated strong discriminatory accuracy (AUROC = 0.8999, AUPRC = 0.8745, Precision = 90.13%, FDR = 9.87%), substantially outperforming GENIE3 (AUPRC = 0.6323, FDR = 35.73%) and co-expression correlation (AUPRC = 0.6814). In silico-simulated driver feature silencing correlated with experimental responses (R2 = 0.473, p < 10-122), and master driver signatures significantly stratified overall survival in the METABRIC (n = 320) and TCGA-BRCA (n = 160; p [≤] 0.019) cohorts. Finally, in silico perturbation modeling indicated that multi-target epigenetic combinations achieved 93% topological disruption of oncogenic regulatory connectivity, nominating prioritized candidate circuits for experimental validation.

summary.takeaway: 提出整合单细胞CRISPRi扰动响应与转录因子结合先验的干预式网络推断框架，在TNBC中重建三分调控网络并优先排序主调控因子。
summary.methods: 整合Perturb-seq数据（GSE224986，95,678细胞、11,975 sgRNA）与ENCODE Factorbook ChIP-seq先验，针对MDA-MB-231中819个体细胞突变相关增强子位点构建TF-增强子、增强子-基因和TF-靶基因网络；用SHAP分析非线性转激活；以留出CRISPRi真值做基准，比较GENIE3和共表达相关；在METABRIC与TCGA-BRCA中做生存分层分析。
summary.relevance: 同时对应单细胞扰动与GRN/Regulon主题：利用扰动数据与结合先验推断调控网络。
summary.caveat: 结果主要来自单一细胞系MDA-MB-231的体外系统；生存分层样本量有限；多靶点表观组合的93%拓扑破坏为计算机模拟预测，尚待实验验证。

papers.title: Grounding User Preferences in Shared Multimodal Concepts for Recommendation
papers.abstract: Multimodal recommendation has substantially advanced item understanding by incorporating rich visual and textual content. Yet user preferences are still commonly encoded as implicit signals tied to individual items, leaving recurring semantic factors without persistent identities that can be shared across items. We introduce MKGE, a multimodal knowledge graph framework that represents these factors as canonical, addressable concepts. MKGE induces a domain-adaptive concept vocabulary from item images and titles, grounds each user's interaction history in supported concepts, and jointly models direct user-item evidence and concept-mediated preference signals. By turning recurring semantics into shared coordinates, MKGE enables evidence from different items to accumulate around the same preference factors. Extensive experiments on three public benchmarks demonstrate that MKGE consistently outperforms collaborative, knowledge-graph, multimodal, and recent LLM/MLLM-based recommenders across all six reported metrics. Controlled studies further demonstrate the importance of canonical concept identities and personalized user-concept correspondence, with especially pronounced gains over removing or rewiring the user graph for low-activity users. These results establish canonical multimodal concepts as effective units for preference modeling and transfer. Code, constructed knowledge graphs, and prompts are available at https://github.com/Garden1a-X/MKGE.

summary.takeaway: 提出MKGE，将多模态推荐中反复出现的语义因素表示为规范可寻址概念，构建多模态知识图谱以累积跨物品的用户偏好证据。
summary.methods: 从物品图像和标题诱导领域自适应概念词表；将用户交互历史落地到受支持概念；联合建模直接用户-物品证据与概念中介偏好信号；在三个公开基准上以六项指标与协同、知识图谱、多模态及LLM/MLLM推荐器比较，并进行消融与用户图重构研究。
summary.relevance: 属于知识图谱主题：用多模态知识图谱中的规范概念作为偏好建模单元。
summary.caveat: 摘要未列出具体数据集与指标数值；对概念词表构建失败或长尾概念覆盖不足的情形未讨论。

papers.title: Tune for Retention, Not Just Gain: SFT Forgets Far Less than You Think
papers.abstract: Catastrophic forgetting, the drastic loss of previously acquired capabilities when learning new ones, is a central challenge in language model fine-tuning. Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is widely believed to be prone to such forgetting. Recent works have attributed this to the off-policy nature of SFT, arguing that on-policy learning is key to continual learning. In this paper, we challenge this premise. We show that while maximizing new-task performance can induce catastrophic forgetting, alternative hyperparameter choices (lower learning rate and batch size) can yield similar gains with little to no forgetting. With hyperparameters selected jointly for gain and retention, vanilla SFT retains prior capabilities far better than previously suggested and can be competitive with Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning (SDFT), an on-policy approach designed to mitigate forgetting. While SDFT can be more robust to hyperparameter choices, it also requires a retention-aware criterion to identify hyperparameter configurations that avoid catastrophic forgetting. Our results challenge the view that on-policy training is what enables learning with retention and raise broader questions about what drives catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning.

summary.takeaway: 挑战SFT必然导致灾难性遗忘的观点，表明联合选择较低学习率和批大小等超参数可在获得新任务增益的同时显著减少遗忘，普通SFT的保持能力可与on-policy的SDFT竞争。
summary.methods: 分析SFT超参数对增益与保持的影响；与Self-Distillation Fine-Tuning（SDFT）比较；指出SDFT对超参数更鲁棒但仍需保持感知准则来避免灾难性遗忘。
summary.relevance: 属于持续学习主题：重新审视on-policy学习与灾难性遗忘之间的因果关系假设。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和遗忘指标数值；结论基于所考察的超参数范围，未说明是否适用于更大规模预训练模型。

papers.title: An Evolutionarily Conserved prrx1-wwp2 Enhancer Axis Regulates Osteogenic Differentiation in Tendon-associated Progenitors.
papers.abstract: Tendon ossification (THO) occurs in distinct physiological and pathological contexts across vertebrates. In some teleosts, myoseptal tendon ossification is a physiological process that generates intermuscular bones (IBs), whereas tendon ossification in mammals typically occurs in pathological contexts. Whether these contexts share conserved mechanisms remains unclear. Here, we used time-resolved scRNA-seq and scATAC-seq analyses to investigate the cellular and regulatory basis of tendon ossification in zebrafish. We identify prrx1+ progenitors within myosepta as a tendon-associated progenitor population that is spatially and transcriptionally associated with osteogenic differentiation during IB formation, and reconstruct a gene regulatory network associated with this process. Cross-species integration reveals conserved cellular and molecular features of THO-associated cell populations between zebrafish and mammals. Functional perturbation analyses reveal that disruption of prrx1 impairs osteogenic differentiation in zebrafish and human tendon-associated progenitor cells. Integration of genome-wide association studies with cross-species scRNA-seq data identifies wwp2 as a conserved regulator associated with this osteogenic program. Further cis-regulatory analyses uncover a functionally conserved wwp2 enhancer associated with prrx1-mediated regulation of wwp2 expression. Together, these findings support an evolutionarily conserved prrx1-wwp2 enhancer axis underlying osteogenic differentiation and provide insight into shared molecular features between physiological tendon ossification in zebrafish and pathological heterotopic ossification in mammals.

summary.takeaway: 研究利用斑马鱼肌腱骨化模型，发现 prrx1+ 肌腱相关祖细胞通过保守的 prrx1-wwp2 增强子轴调控成骨分化，并提示鱼类生理性肌腱骨化与哺乳动物病理性异位骨化存在共享分子特征。
summary.methods: 对斑马鱼进行时间分辨 scRNA-seq 和 scATAC-seq，重建与肌隔膜骨化相关的基因调控网络；跨物种整合斑马鱼与哺乳动物单细胞数据；功能扰动实验检验 prrx1 在斑马鱼及人肌腱相关祖细胞成骨分化中的作用；整合 GWAS 与跨物种单细胞数据识别 wwp2；cis-调控分析鉴定受 prrx1 调控的 wwp2 增强子。
summary.relevance: 该研究围绕基因调控网络/Regulon，构建了肌腱骨化相关祖细胞的调控网络，并鉴定 prrx1 与 wwp2 增强子轴，为理解保守的转录调控程序提供依据。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出样本量、扰动实验的定量效应及跨物种整合的具体方法细节；prrx1-wwp2 轴的因果强度及增强子功能保守程度需查阅全文确认。
